    "            lookback=lookback,\n",
    "            forecast_horizon=forecast_horizon\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        model = Pipeline([\n",
    "\n",
    "            (\n",
    "                \"classifier\",\n",
    "                LGBMClassifier(\n",
    "\n",
    "                    n_estimators=300,\n",
    "                    learning_rate=0.05,\n",
    "                    max_depth=8,\n",
    "\n",
    "                    random_state=42\n",
    "                )\n",
    "            )\n",
    "        ])\n",
    "\n",
    "        model.fit(\n",
    "            X_train,\n",
    "            y_train\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        y_pred = model.predict(\n",
    "            X_test\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        y_prob = model.predict_proba(\n",
    "            X_test\n",
    "        )[:, 1]\n",
    "\n",
    "        metrics = evaluate_model(\n",
    "            y_test,\n",
    "            y_pred,\n",
    "            y_prob\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        result_row = create_result_row(\n",
    "            province=province_name,\n",
    "            lookback=lookback,\n",
    "            forecast_horizon=forecast_horizon,\n",
    "            metrics=metrics\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        province_results.append(\n",
    "            result_row\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        trained_models[\n",
    "            (\n",
    "                lookback,\n",
    "                forecast_horizon\n",
    "            )\n",
    "        ] = {\n",
    "            \"model\": model,\n",
    "            \"metrics\": metrics\n",
    "        }\n"
   ]

    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
    "    print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
    "    print(\"TOP 3 MODELS\")\n",
    "    print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\n",
    "        ranked_df.head(3)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ======================================\n",
    "    # SAVE TOP 3 MODELS\n",
    "    # ======================================\n",
    "\n",
    "    top_3_models = ranked_df.head(3)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for rank, (_, row) in enumerate(\n",
    "        top_3_models.iterrows(),\n",
    "        start=1\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "\n",
    "        lookback = int(\n",
    "            row[\"lookback\"]\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        forecast_horizon = int(\n",
    "            row[\"forecast_horizon\"]\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "        # LOAD MODEL\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "        model = trained_models[\n",
    "            (\n",
    "                lookback,\n",
    "                forecast_horizon\n",
    "            )\n",
    "        ][\"model\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "        # LOAD METRICS\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "        metrics = trained_models[\n",
    "            (\n",
    "                lookback,\n",
    "                forecast_horizon\n",
    "            )\n",
    "        ][\"metrics\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "        # METADATA\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "        metadata = {\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"province\":\n",
    "                province_name,\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"model_rank\":\n",
    "                rank,\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"algorithm\":\n",
    "                \"LogisticRegression\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"lookback\":\n",
    "                lookback,\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"forecast_horizon\":\n",
    "                forecast_horizon,\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"accuracy\":\n",
    "                float(metrics[\"accuracy\"]),\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"precision\":\n",
    "                float(metrics[\"precision\"]),\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"recall\":\n",
    "                float(metrics[\"recall\"]),\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"f1\":\n",
    "                float(metrics[\"f1\"]),\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"roc_auc\":\n",
    "                float(metrics[\"roc_auc\"])\n",
    "        }\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "        # SAVE MODEL\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "        save_complete_model_package(\n",
    "\n",
    "            algorithm_name=\n",
    "                \"LogisticRegression\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            province_name=\n",
    "                province_name,\n",
    "\n",
    "            forecast_horizon=\n",
    "                forecast_horizon,\n",
    "\n",
    "            model_rank=\n",
    "                rank,\n",
    "\n",
    "            model=\n",
    "                model,\n",
    "\n",
    "            metadata=\n",
    "                metadata\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        print(\n",
    "            f\"\\nSaved TOP {rank} | \"\n",
    "            f\"Lookback={lookback} | \"\n",
    "            f\"Horizon={forecast_horizon}\"\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
    "    print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
    "    print(f\"FINISHED: {province_name}\")\n",
    "    print(\"=\" * 60)"
   ]
  },

   "source": [
    "# ======================================\n",
    "# GET TOP 3\n",
    "# ======================================\n",
    "\n",
    "top_3_models = ranked_df.head(3)\n",
    "\n",
    "for rank, (_, row) in enumerate(\n",
    "    top_3_models.iterrows(),\n",
    "    start=1\n",
    "):\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ==================================\n",
    "    # GET LOOKBACK\n",
    "    # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "    lookback = int(\n",
    "        row[\"lookback\"]\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ==================================\n",
    "    # GET FORECAST HORIZON\n",
    "    # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "    forecast_horizon = int(\n",
    "        row[\"forecast_horizon\"]\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ==================================\n",
    "    # LOAD TRAINED MODEL\n",
    "    # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "    model = trained_models[\n",
    "        (\n",
    "            lookback,\n",
    "            forecast_horizon\n",
    "        )\n",
    "    ][\"model\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ==================================\n",
    "    # LOAD METRICS\n",
    "    # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "    metrics = trained_models[\n",
    "        (\n",
    "            lookback,\n",
    "            forecast_horizon\n",
    "        )\n",
    "    ][\"metrics\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ==================================\n",
    "    # CREATE METADATA\n",
    "    # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "    metadata = {\n",
    "\n",
    "        \"province\":\n",
    "            province_name,\n",
    "\n",
    "        \"model_rank\":\n",
    "            rank,\n",
    "\n",
    "        \"algorithm\":\n",
    "            \"RandomForest\",\n",
    "\n",
    "        \"lookback\":\n",
    "            lookback,\n",
    "\n",
    "        \"forecast_horizon\":\n",
    "            forecast_horizon,\n",
    "\n",
    "        \"accuracy\":\n",
    "            float(metrics[\"accuracy\"]),\n",
    "\n",
    "        \"precision\":\n",
    "            float(metrics[\"precision\"]),\n",
    "\n",
    "        \"recall\":\n",
    "            float(metrics[\"recall\"]),\n",
    "\n",
    "        \"f1\":\n",
    "            float(metrics[\"f1\"]),\n",
    "\n",
    "        \"roc_auc\":\n",
    "            float(metrics[\"roc_auc\"])\n",
    "    }\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ==================================\n",
    "    # SAVE MODEL PACKAGE\n",
    "    # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "    save_complete_model_package(\n",
    "\n",
    "        algorithm_name=\n",
    "            \"RandomForest\",\n",
    "\n",
    "        province_name=\n",
    "            province_name,\n",
    "\n",
    "        forecast_horizon=\n",
    "            forecast_horizon,\n",
    "\n",
    "        model_rank=\n",
    "            rank,\n",
    "\n",
    "        model=\n",
    "            model,\n",
    "\n",
    "        metadata=\n",
    "            metadata\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\n",
    "        f\"\\nSaved TOP {rank} | \"\n",
    "        f\"Lookback={lookback} | \"\n",
    "        f\"Horizon={forecast_horizon}\"\n",
    "    )"
   ]

    "\n",
    "            model.fit(\n",
    "                X_train,\n",
    "                y_train\n",
    "            )\n",
    "\n",
    "            # ==============================\n",
    "            # PREDICT\n",
    "            # ==============================\n",
    "\n",
    "            y_pred = model.predict(\n",
    "                X_test\n",
    "            )\n",
    "\n",
    "            y_prob = model.predict_proba(\n",
    "                X_test\n",
    "            )[:, 1]\n",
    "\n",
    "            # ==============================\n",
    "            # EVALUATE\n",
    "            # ==============================\n",
    "\n",
    "            metrics = evaluate_model(\n",
    "                y_test,\n",
    "                y_pred,\n",
    "                y_prob\n",
    "            )\n",
    "\n",
    "            # ==============================\n",
    "            # RESULT ROW\n",
    "            # ==============================\n",
    "\n",
    "            result_row = create_result_row(\n",
    "                province=province_name,\n",
    "                lookback=lookback,\n",
    "                forecast_horizon=forecast_horizon,\n",
    "                metrics=metrics\n",
    "            )\n",
    "\n",
    "            province_results.append(\n",
    "                result_row\n",
    "            )\n",
    "\n",
    "            ALL_RESULTS.append(\n",
    "                result_row\n",
    "            )\n",
    "\n",
    "            # ==============================\n",
    "            # STORE MODEL\n",
    "            # ==============================\n",
    "\n",
    "            trained_models[\n",
    "                (\n",
    "                    lookback,\n",
    "                    forecast_horizon\n",
    "                )\n",
    "            ] = {\n",
    "\n",
    "                \"model\":\n",
    "                    model,\n",
    "\n",
    "                \"metrics\":\n",
    "                    metrics\n",
    "            }\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ======================================\n",
    "    # CREATE RESULTS DATAFRAME\n",
    "    # ======================================\n",
    "\n",
    "    province_results_df = (\n",
    "        create_results_dataframe(\n",
    "            province_results\n",
    "        )\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ======================================\n",
    "    # RANK MODELS\n",
    "    # ======================================\n",
    "\n",
    "    ranked_df = rank_models(\n",
    "        province_results_df\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
    "    print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
    "    print(\"TOP 3 MODELS\")\n",
    "    print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\n",
    "        ranked_df.head(3)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # ======================================\n",
    "    # SAVE TOP 3 MODELS\n",
    "    # ======================================\n",
    "\n",
    "    top_3_models = ranked_df.head(3)\n",
    "\n",
    "    for rank, (_, row) in enumerate(\n",
    "        top_3_models.iterrows(),\n",
    "        start=1\n",
    "    ):\n",
    "\n",
    "        lookback = int(\n",
    "            row[\"lookback\"]\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        forecast_horizon = int(\n",
    "            row[\"forecast_horizon\"]\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "        # LOAD MODEL\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "        model = trained_models[\n",
    "            (\n",
    "                lookback,\n",
    "                forecast_horizon\n",
    "            )\n",
    "        ][\"model\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "        # LOAD METRICS\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "        metrics = trained_models[\n",
    "            (\n",
    "                lookback,\n",
    "                forecast_horizon\n",
    "            )\n",
    "        ][\"metrics\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "        # METADATA\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "        metadata = {\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"province\":\n",
    "                province_name,\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"model_rank\":\n",
    "                rank,\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"algorithm\":\n",
    "                \"XGBoost\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"lookback\":\n",
    "                lookback,\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"forecast_horizon\":\n",
    "                forecast_horizon,\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"accuracy\":\n",
    "                float(metrics[\"accuracy\"]),\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"precision\":\n",
    "                float(metrics[\"precision\"]),\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"recall\":\n",
    "                float(metrics[\"recall\"]),\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"f1\":\n",
    "                float(metrics[\"f1\"]),\n",
    "\n",
    "            \"roc_auc\":\n",
    "                float(metrics[\"roc_auc\"])\n",
    "        }\n",
    "\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "        # SAVE MODEL\n",
    "        # ==================================\n",
    "\n",
    "        save_complete_model_package(\n",
    "\n",
    "            algorithm_name=\n",
    "                \"XGBoost\",\n",
    "\n",
    "            province_name=\n",
    "                province_name,\n",
    "\n",
    "            forecast_horizon=\n",
    "                forecast_horizon,\n",
    "\n",
    "            model_rank=\n",
    "                rank,\n",
    "\n",
    "            model=\n",
    "                model,\n",
    "\n",
    "            metadata=\n",
    "                metadata\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        print(\n",
    "            f\"\\nSaved TOP {rank} | \"\n",
    "            f\"Lookback={lookback} | \"\n",
    "            f\"Horizon={forecast_horizon}\"\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    print(\"\\n\")\n",
    "    print(\"=\" * 60)\n",
    "    print(f\"FINISHED: {province_name}\")\n",
    "    print(\"=\" * 60)"
   ]
